cases.answer: You used invoice-sample.pdf. The instructor said everyone should have it from the shared course folder, and it was the file for the whole exercise. You ran the automation on it to check that the supplier name and total came out right. The slides list the same step: "Test on invoice-sample.pdf".

The Publish button is now called Deploy. In the session the instructor clicked Publish at the top right to make the automation live. The documentation says Deploy replaced Publish in version 4.2 and works the same way. To make your automation live, choose Deploy at the top right of the automation editor. It then starts listening for its trigger straight away. To stop it, choose Pause.

A failed step is retried up to three times, waiting 1, 5 and then 15 minutes between attempts. Yes, you can change it. Open Automation settings, then Reliability, and set Retries to a number from 0 to 5. In the session, the instructor said a failed step is retried and that every attempt shows on the Runs tab. The documentation says the same.

The When a file arrives trigger accepts files up to 20 MB each. It only takes PDF, PNG and JPEG files. Larger files and other file types are skipped, and each skipped file is listed on the Runs tab with the reason. In the session you pointed the trigger at your Invoices inbox and tested it with invoice-sample.pdf, but the session did not mention a size limit.

Before Session 4, the instructor asked you to connect your own invoices inbox and run the automation on five real invoices. Bring any invoices that came out wrong. Session 4 will start with fixing the extraction instructions together.

Yes, a question in the session asked whether the automation tries again if the agent step fails. The instructor said yes: a failed step is retried, and every attempt appears on the Runs tab so you can see what happened. The product documentation adds detail: a failed step is retried up to three times, waiting 1, 5 and then 15 minutes. To change the number of retries, open Automation settings, then Reliability, and set Retries to a number from 0 to 5.

This was covered in Session 2, where the workspace was set up. Workspace admins add teammates like this:
1. Go to Settings.
2. Open Members.
3. Choose Invite.
4. Enter the teammate's email and pick their role.

The teammate gets an email and joins with the role you chose. Note: I found no product documentation on this, so the steps come from Session 2's recording and an instructor's earlier verified answer.
